### T9: vehicle depot MVP — parking bays, lanes, Dubins turning paths

`3173bff` · 2026-09-25

Reference depot (30 x 18 m, a two-way lane, six perpendicular bays,
two parked vehicles), a clean-room Dubins path planner in
packages/industry, and a swept-body entry check (minimum-turning-
radius curve from the nearest lane into each empty bay, sampled every
20 cm against walls, columns, other vehicles and no-go zones).
A bay is a zone (Space.zones), not an item: modelling it as an item
first made every parked vehicle "overlap" its own bay, since the
core's overlap check compares vertical extent and a floor marking and
a car both start at the floor. Zones and items are never compared for
overlap, so this was the correct fix.
bay-boundary and bay-entry rules, depot metrics, editor panel with a
visible entry path in 2D/3D, agent tools (add_depot_bay,
add_depot_zone, depot_metrics, bay_entry_check), report section,
browser journey. Decision 0013 has the full account, including two
real bugs a hand-calculated test and forward-simulation property test

### Warehouse: give racks visible pallet loads

`b4aeb29` · 2026-09-25

Rack rows rendered as bare metal frames with no goods, which read as
empty shelving rather than a stocked warehouse. Add a load per bay
group on every level (capped at 3 groups per level so a very long
rack's template stays bounded — every rack row is its own definition
with no cross-rack instancing, so per-template mesh count multiplies
by rack count). Verified at 100-rack scale: 3D mount time matches the
pre-change baseline (~5.6s vs ~5.9s), not the ~16s an earlier
per-position version regressed to.

### T7: fix rack-inspector field overlap and a severe warehouse routing bug

`3133f63` · 2026-09-25

Browser-tested T7 end to end now that Chromium is available, and found
two real defects along the way:
- The rack-capacity inspector's six fields used inset labels too long
  for the default label slot, so the label text overlapped the typed
  number. Gave each field the existing wideKey treatment and a full
  width row.
- checkWarehouse ran one full-grid Dijkstra search per (dock, rack,
  access-face) triple - up to 800 searches at 100 racks, 24-39s
  measured through the live server. Added reachabilityFrom/distanceAt
  to packages/industry so one flood-fill search per dock answers every
  rack's reachability (~380ms now). Covered by a dense 100-row
  regression test that fails without the fix (verified by reverting
  it), plus an exhaustive agreement test against findRoute.
Decision 0011, TASKS.md and the industrial packs plan updated; T7
marked done.

### Core C4: commands, inverses, batches and undo/redo history

`1c4ab1d` · 2026-09-25

- commands/apply: pure apply() for item add/move/rotate/remove/lock,
  catalog define/remove, space set and atomic nested batches; each
  accepted command returns its inverse and bumps revision once
- Integrity rejections with stable codes (duplicate id across all
  entities, missing reference, locked, in use, invalid payload with
  field-level problems, failing batch position)
- commands/history: execute/undo/redo with bounded undo stack; undo is a
  new revision, history is never rewritten
- validate: reusable space/definition/item validators; unknown fields
  are rejected so stray data never reaches a save file
- Property test: up to 100 random commands (incl. batches), every state
  valid, undo-all restores the original, redo-all restores the final
